audit_items.proof_trace: The function correctly implements both conditions: `self.debt = self.debt.add(interest_accumulated)` (L142) satisfies `debt_post == debt_pre + interest`, and `self.cash_reserve = self.cash_reserve.add(reserve_factor.mul(interest_accumulated))` (L143) satisfies `cash_reserve_post == cash_reserve_pre + interest * reserve_factor`. All callers flow through the market.move wrapper (L1015-1028) which consistently passes `asset.repay_fee_rate()` as the reserve_factor; the formula is applied on every non-degenerate accrual path. The design concern that `repay_fee_rate` serves double duty as reserve_factor is a distinct issue covered by PROP-01b-partial-asm-003.
